title: Crawfish scan IMG_4109 through quad_layout
user-messages: landed yes spin up on agent per scan and a ticket per and have them diagonse and attempt to fix each individually
description:
Crawfish scan IMG_4109 does not get through quad_layout after repair_mesh. The repair itself is clean on all ten scans since CRAW-130 (0 folds, 0 zero-length edges, 0 holes, quad_layout's input fold check passes); the failure is in a later stage. Last observed failure (2026-11-23, measured before CRAW-130's final rewrite landed, so re-run first): embedding: 'T-mesh node 42918 has no barycentric in source face 560053'; the motorcycle graph logged ambiguous ports (two arcs leaving in the same direction) and an invalid fold-back cycle at that node.

All ten crawfish scans fail somewhere in quad_layout (CRAW-131 to CRAW-140, one ticket per scan). Their cross fields are very noisy (500-1324 cones) and their genus is 2-10 where a crawfish should be 0, probably legs and antennae touching the body, so a shared cause is likely; this ticket diagnoses this scan's failure on its own and fixes it the way the quad-layout papers intend, and says whether the cause is shared.
definition-of-done:
1. The furthest stage IMG_4109 reaches on current master is re-measured, with the failure message and the stage times.
2. The root cause is diagnosed with evidence (numbers, engine screenshots, saved diagnostic output under tmp/), naming the stage, the mesh feature that triggers it, and whether it is shared with the other crawfish scans.
3. A fix following the relevant paper is implemented and IMG_4109 gets through quad_layout with 0 folds, shown in the engine with a screenshot of the quad layout; or concrete evidence shows why it cannot be fixed in this ticket and what it needs instead.
4. No regression: the 11 quad-layout suite models give the same quad, patch and cone counts as master, and ixd wt perf shows no regression on the ticket's perf benchmarks.
testing-plan:
1. Run load_mesh -> repair_mesh -> quad_layout (crawfish settings) on IMG_4109 headless with a per-run timeout, record the stage reached and the stage times.
2. After the fix, rerun IMG_4109 and the 11 suite models (block, bolt, botijo, buddha, elk, fandisk, feline, fertility, hand, rockerarm, sphere_base) and compare against master.
